title: emerald update+
description: This is a emerald update mod.The mod add some emerald items.
body:
# emerald update
new emerald update mod has any song,song update.
mod add emerald ingot,craft,tool,paint,debug items and happy items.

## Mod description
Have you been annoyed that emeralds can only be traded and decorated and have no practical effect? Come and try this mod! 

## install
After downloading, you need the version of neoforge 1.21.4~1.21.8, and then open the backpack after installation, and you can play.
create by lchmc2013 and mcreator.
